levels.title: HSK 1 · Novice Survival Foundations
levels.description: Essential greetings, numbers, family, time, food, daily SVO sentences, and core particles (是, 有, 在, 吗).

units.title: Unit 1 · Greetings, Identity & Pronouns
units.description: Introduce yourself, ask polite questions with 吗 and 呢, and use equative verb 是.

units.title: Unit 2 · Time, Family, Dining & Checkpoint
units.description: Express possession with 有/没有, locations with 在, ordering food, and HSK 1 mastery test.

levels.title: HSK 2 · Elementary Daily Communication
levels.description: Comparisons (比), completed vs experiential aspect (了/过), structural particles (的/地/得), and travel dialogues.

units.title: Unit 1 · Comparisons, Aspect & Concessions
units.description: Compare options with 比, contrast past experience (过) with completion (了), and link clauses with 虽然…但是…
grammarTargets: Verb + 过 vs Verb + 了

levels.title: HSK 3 · Intermediate Fluency & Complements
levels.description: Object manipulation with 把, passive voice with 被, directional/potential complements, and workplace communication.

units.title: Unit 1 · Disposal (把), Passive (被) & Complements
units.description: Master object manipulation with 把, passive voice with 被, and directional complements.

levels.title: HSK 4 · Upper-Intermediate Discourse & Society
levels.description: Formal discourse connectors (无论…都…, 不仅…而且…), professional registers, and multi-clause reading.

units.title: Unit 1 · Formal Connectors & Professional Registers
units.description: Build structured arguments using 无论…都…, 不仅…而且…, and 即使…也…

levels.title: HSK 5 · Advanced Media, Literature & Idioms
levels.description: Four-character idioms (成语), effect-first causal frames (之所以…是因为…), and newspaper/essay analysis.

units.title: Unit 1 · Chengyu & Analytical Discourse
units.description: Deploy classical four-character idioms (画蛇添足, 半途而废) and effect-first causal frames.

levels.title: HSK 6 · Mastery Rhetoric & Classical Registers
levels.description: Literary Chinese particles, rhetorical preference frames (与其…不如…), and academic synthesis.

units.title: Unit 1 · Literary Particles & Rhetorical Mastery
units.description: Synthesize formal arguments with 与其…不如…, 举一反三, and 潜移默化.
